messages:
deploy-bot: Starting release rollout: release-2.7.1. Feature-flag plan = 'cohort-matrix-softpause'. Canary -> internal(100%), beta(20%), prod-slice ramp 1% -> 10% -> 50% every 10m. Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Watch: latency / 5xx / gen_quality. Runbook: https://runbook.internal/ff-rollout

riley: tagging @nina-oncall - canary hold for 15m health check?

nina-oncall: I'll monitor. Set alert thresholds: p95_latency +20% OR 5xx > 0.5% OR gen_score drop >= 3pts -> auto-hold.

maya: pushing flag config now, snippet:
```
feature_flags:
  new_gen_path:
    cohorts:
      internal: 100
      beta: 20
      prod_slice: [1, 10, 50] # ramp steps, every 10m
    rollback_variant: release-2.6.8
    kill_switch: true
```

sam: should we pin fallback model to v2.6.8 for prod-slice in case gen-quality regresses?

alex: yes. Pin fallback logic: if gen_score delta <= -3 -> route to release-2.6.8. Also ensure KV-cache warmup for new pods.

opsbot: Autoscaler config updated: warmup_seconds=120, max_surge=20%. On error spike autoscaler will drain to previous stable variant (release-2.6.8).

deploy-bot: internal cohort deployed -> OK. beta rolling in 2m. Logs: deployment-4951236789: ok.

riley: seeing p95 +18% on beta (baseline->+18). under threshold but close. hold progression?

nina-oncall: pausing progression at beta. Collecting traces and logs. @maya please run quick perf diff and try temporary config tweak to reduce latency.

maya: quick patch: reduce batch_size 32 -> 16 for canary pods. Applying now and redeploying beta.

deploy-bot: patched config applied to beta. New metrics: p95 back to ~+3%.

nina-oncall: good. Resume ramp to prod-slice at 1% for 10m. Rollback conditions restated: gen_score drop >=3 OR 5xx > 0.5% OR p95 > 25%.

sam: :thumbsup: updating release notes and the customer-facing changelog. Adding rollback playbook link: https://runbook.internal/release-ff-rollback

alex: note: if we need to stop ramping but keep traffic at last healthy percentage, we'll use 'softpause' (no automatic forward steps). That keeps flag live but halts progression.

deploy-bot: progressed prod-slice -> 1% -> 5% -> 15% across windows. No sign of gen-quality regression, 5xx and latency stable. Last check-in (22:37 UTC): all green.

riley: leaving monitoring on for the quiet window. If anything, escalate to SRE channel.

nina-oncall: keeping thread open until full rollout completes. If no issues after final 50% step, will close. Thanks everyone.
